items.title: Morning Minute: Bitcoin Tops JPMorgan’s Ten-Year Forecast for All Assets

items.title: OCC Finalizes GENIUS Act Stablecoin Rules Ahead of January Deadline
items.summary: The rule sets reserve, redemption and risk standards for issuers, but the OCC has yet to say when it will begin accepting applications.

items.title: 'Mentality Issue': PlayStation Founder Waves Away Disc Ownership Anger
